issues.description: Constructor parameter types differ between the template header and the template implementation (and differ from the solution). In template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp the constructor is declared as: Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height); but the template implementation in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp defines the constructor as: Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height). The solution header declares Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height). The mismatch of parameter types (long vs int) between the header and the implementation will cause a linkage/compilation error (the implementation does not match the declared signature) and will confuse students about the correct API to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration in the template header match the implementation and the solution. Change the constructor declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height);' to 'Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height);' so the header and implementation use the same parameter types and the symbol resolves correctly during linking.

issues.description: Parameter identifier names for the Bitmap24 constructor differ between header and implementation in the template. The template header declares the constructor parameter names as 'i_width' and 'i_height' (Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height);) while the template implementation uses parameter names 'p_width' and 'p_height' (Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height) ...). The solution header uses 'i_width'/'i_height'. While parameter names do not affect linkage, this inconsistency increases cognitive load and can confuse students when mapping the API (header) to the implementation (cpp) and when reading or modifying the code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify parameter names between header and implementation to reduce confusion. Update the template implementation signature to use the same parameter identifiers as the header/solution (e.g. change 'Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height)' to 'Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height)') or update the header to match the implementation. Prefer matching the solution naming ('i_width', 'i_height') for consistency.
